records.title: Monero activates Ring Confidential Transactions
records.summary: Monero implemented RingCT, hiding transaction amounts in addition to obscuring transaction origins.
records.significance: RingCT materially strengthened Monero's privacy model and became a defining component of private cryptocurrency transactions.

records.title: SEC rejects Winklevoss Bitcoin ETF proposal
records.summary: The SEC rejected Bats BZX's proposal to list the Winklevoss Bitcoin Trust.
records.significance: The denial became an early milestone in the long US battle over a spot Bitcoin exchange-traded product.

records.title: Ethereum Name Service launches .eth names
records.summary: The initial ENS registrar deployed to Ethereum mainnet, enabling human-readable .eth names.
records.significance: ENS made naming and identity a central part of Ethereum wallet and application UX.

records.title: Curio Cards launches early Ethereum collectible art
records.summary: Curio Cards debuted as an Ethereum art gallery and collectible-card series.
records.significance: The collection predates CryptoPunks and is one of Ethereum's earliest original digital-art NFT projects.

records.title: New York Agreement proposes SegWit2x compromise
records.summary: Major Bitcoin companies and miners announced an agreement supporting SegWit activation followed by a planned 2 MB hard fork.
records.significance: The agreement became the corporate/miner side of the climactic Bitcoin block-size war.

sources.title: Digital Currency Group — Bitcoin Scaling Agreement at Consensus 2017

records.title: CryptoPunks launches
records.summary: Larva Labs launched 10,000 algorithmically generated CryptoPunks on Ethereum, initially claimable for free.
records.significance: CryptoPunks became the prototype for the modern profile-picture NFT collection.

records.title: EOS begins its year-long token sale
records.summary: Block.one conducted the EOS ERC-20 token sale from 26 June 2017 through 1 June 2018, distributing 900 million public-sale tokens through an approximately year-long ICO.
records.significance: EOS became one of the largest and longest-running token sales of the ICO era and a major example in the later US securities-enforcement response to token fundraising.

records.title: Binance launches
records.summary: Binance launched its exchange after a June-to-July BNB token sale.
records.significance: Binance grew into the world's largest crypto exchange and one of the industry's most powerful institutions.

records.title: SEC DAO Report applies securities law to token offerings
records.summary: The SEC concluded that DAO tokens were securities and warned that federal securities laws can apply to blockchain token offerings.
records.significance: The report was the foundational US securities-law turning point for the ICO era.

records.title: Bitcoin Cash splits from Bitcoin
records.summary: Bitcoin Cash separated from Bitcoin after block 478,558 and adopted rules allowing larger blocks.
records.significance: It was the most consequential permanent split of the Bitcoin block-size war.

sources.title: IRS — Bitcoin / Bitcoin Cash hard fork background

records.title: SegWit activates on Bitcoin
records.summary: Segregated Witness activated on Bitcoin mainnet after locking in earlier in August.
records.significance: SegWit fixed transaction malleability, increased effective block capacity and enabled more robust payment-channel systems.

records.title: China bans ICO fundraising
records.summary: Chinese financial regulators declared token fundraising an unauthorized and illegal public-financing activity and ordered existing offerings to unwind.
records.significance: The ban abruptly ended China's domestic ICO boom and became one of 2017's largest regulatory shocks.

sources.title: Chinese regulators — ICO financing risk notice

records.title: Chainlink whitepaper introduces decentralized oracle network
records.summary: The ChainLink v1 whitepaper proposed a decentralized oracle network connecting smart contracts to external data and systems.
records.significance: Chainlink later became dominant oracle infrastructure for DeFi and smart contracts.

records.title: Cardano mainnet era begins
records.summary: Cardano's genesis block is dated 23 September 2017 and its Byron mainnet era launched on 29 September.
records.significance: Cardano became a major research-driven proof-of-stake smart-contract ecosystem.

records.title: Carlos Matos delivers legendary BitConnect presentation
records.summary: Carlos Matos delivered his exuberant BitConnect presentation at the project's annual ceremony in Thailand.
records.significance: The 'BitConneeeect!' performance became one of crypto's most enduring memes and later a symbol of the platform's collapse.

records.title: SegWit2x hard fork is cancelled
records.summary: Key SegWit2x backers cancelled the planned 2 MB hard fork because sufficient consensus had not been achieved.
records.significance: The cancellation effectively ended the central 2017 block-size confrontation.

records.title: CryptoKitties launches
records.summary: Axiom Zen launched CryptoKitties publicly on Ethereum.
records.significance: The game's viral breeding and trading mechanics introduced NFTs to a much wider audience and visibly stressed Ethereum capacity.

records.title: Cboe launches regulated Bitcoin futures
records.summary: Cboe Futures Exchange opened trading in cash-settled Bitcoin futures.
records.significance: It was the first US regulated exchange-traded Bitcoin futures contract to go live.

records.title: CME Bitcoin futures launch
records.summary: CME listed its Bitcoin futures contract for the 18 December trade date.
records.significance: CME brought Bitcoin into one of the world's largest regulated derivatives markets.

records.title: MakerDAO launches Single-Collateral Dai
records.summary: MakerDAO's first production Dai system went live on Ethereum, initially backed by Ether.
records.significance: Dai demonstrated a decentralized, overcollateralized stablecoin and became foundational DeFi infrastructure.

records.title: Litecoin creator Charlie Lee sells or donates nearly all LTC holdings
records.summary: Charlie Lee announced he had sold or donated nearly all his Litecoin holdings, citing the conflict created by his public influence.
records.significance: The move remains one of crypto's most debated founder-divestment decisions.

sources.title: TechCrunch — Charlie Lee sells Litecoin holdings
